query: What operational burdens appear in incident descriptions?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the type of incident (database, email, VPN) rather than an aspect of the burden it imposes. It is a descriptive taxonomy of the incident subject matter, not a part of operational burden itself.

per_column.name: failure_pattern
per_column.rationale: Describes the technical mode of failure (connectivity failure, access denied). This is a source/cause of burden, not a constitutive aspect of the burden concept.

per_column.name: affected_resource_type
per_column.rationale: Identifies what infrastructure is affected. This characterizes the incident's target, not a facet of the operational burden.

per_column.name: incident_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope/blast radius (system-wide vs user-specific) is a genuine constitutive dimension of how much operational burden an incident imposes -- breadth of impact is an aspect OF burden.

per_column.name: task_nature
per_column.rationale: The nature of work required (break-fix, access request, maintenance) is an aspect of the operational effort/burden -- it partly constitutes what the burden consists of.

per_column.name: cross_resolver
per_column.rationale: Whether resolution spans multiple resolver groups is a coordination-cost aspect of operational burden -- a constitutive part of the effort dimension.

per_column.name: off_hours_incident
per_column.rationale: Timing (off-hours) is a real burden aspect since after-hours handling imposes additional operational cost -- an aspect OF the burden.

per_column.name: recurrence_signal
per_column.rationale: Recurrence reflects repeated/ongoing burden, a temporal-persistence aspect of operational burden that is constitutive of its magnitude.

judge.rationale: Only five of eight columns qualify as constitutive facets of operational burden. incident_category, failure_pattern, and affected_resource_type describe WHAT the incident is or its cause/target, not aspects of the burden it imposes -- they are external descriptors, not meronymic parts. Among the true facets, mutual exclusivity is fairly good: scope, task nature, coordination (cross-resolver), timing, and recurrence tap distinct dimensions, though incident_scope and cross_resolver partially co-vary (breadth often drives cross-team involvement), and recurrence/off-hours both index temporal burden with modest overlap. Exhaustiveness is only moderate: key burden dimensions such as resolution effort/duration, priority/urgency severity, volume, and rework are not directly captured; the set leans on categorical incident attributes and leaves the effort-magnitude and time-to-resolve aspects of burden underrepresented.
